form.title: Data Curator QC (DCQC)
form.description: Runs DCQC checks against files listed in a samplesheet CSV of Synapse URIs (columns: url, file_type, md5_checksum, optional test). Select a dataset containing exactly one samplesheet CSV as the input.

required_tests.title: Required tests
required_tests.description: Comma-separated list of tests that are required for a file to pass QC (e.g. Md5ChecksumTest,FileExtensionTest). Leave blank to use the dcqc defaults.

skipped_tests.title: Skipped tests
skipped_tests.description: Comma-separated list of tests that should be skipped for all files. Leave blank to use the dcqc defaults.
